contexts.text: The evil Spirits shake off there the dust of their feet, when they want to bring anyone to damnation.
Jehovah shook off the Egyptians into the midst of the sea () = that thus they themselves cast themselves into Hell.
If he shall strike out the tooth of his servant, or the tooth of his maidservant () = if he shall destroy truth or the affection thereof in the Sensuous... To strike out = to destroy.
Thy olive shall be shaken () = that good will perish. AE 638:19.
Would put forth its three gods...

To shake off the dust of their feet () = lest what is damned should adhere to them therefrom... Those who belonged to the representative Churches shook off the dust of their feet when the truths of doctrine were not received.
To smite her wealth in the sea () = to cast falsities into Hell.
